title: After the Satsuki Sho: The Angel Who Weaves the Ring

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I will forge that circle... without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Rose & Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!
Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“Victoire Pisa——!!
A magnificent triumph in the Satsuki Sho!!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Kh! The first crown... slipped right through my fingers...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I couldn't reach you...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I failed to bring... glory to my clan!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, no, but still—
...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............That was a magnificent run...!
...The victory is yours, Pisa...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Rose-san...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I am happy... so happy.
Not only for the victory, but above all—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To think that a race with you
could ignite such blazing passion! Look—!
(Woooooaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“She did it! Congrats, Pisa!”
“Roseee!” “You were amazing!”
“What a fierce clash! That totally brought me to tears!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That was way too intense! Ah, sorry, I put my arm around you!"
"No worries, I'm thrilled too!"
"Racing really is the absolute best, isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A staggering 'frenzy'—no.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So this is the 'ring'...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...At the Nippon Derby, I am sure we can create an even greater circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I look forward to your guidance on that grand stage as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes—likewise.
Let us face this with complete resolve.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Without her, that 'circle' would never have come to be.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Nothing is quite so arduous
as forging connections between things unseen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The way she lived her life brought forth that 'circle.'
Her unswerving resolve is what made it so.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While she was already a friend I held in high esteem,
those sentiments have deepened all the more.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The next race is—the Japanese Derby, is it?

I nod at the question. The second leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
A 2,400-meter turf battle held at Tokyo Racecourse—
choice_data_list: 世代の頂点を決める一戦にございます

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I will be facing Pisa once more.
No, she will not be the only formidable rival gathered there.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The title of “Derby Umamusume” is a dazzling crown of glory.
One for which every runner wagers their very soul on the turf.
choice_data_list: レース映像を分析し、対策を練りましょう

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the moment we return to the academy.
—We shall claim the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Flash-san, you're still awake?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You've been going to bed at 11 o'clock sharp lately though~
Did you change your schedule by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have pushed back my bedtime by 60 minutes.
At my current pace, it seemed unlikely I would finish in time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The Satsuki Sho—running shoulder-to-shoulder with them made me realize:
my rivals are formidable, even compared to typical years—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We must factor these variables into our recalculations and face the challenge with flawless preparation.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see! ...It'd be wonderful if you could
show it to the father and mother you respect so deeply.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The sight of her winning the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes—without fail.
Every single one of them, aiming for that pinnacle—

They forged ahead, racing toward their next race:
the Japanese Derby.
